reasons: Both answers meet all four rubric items with similar diagnoses, rewritten prompts, loop controls and checkpoint/retry advice. A edges ahead with concrete loop code that ships the best draft and has an explicit plateau-versus-best check, a score computed directly from the criteria (which reduces score noise), a comparison against the best previous draft, and an explicit 'mark SKU failed and move on' after retries. B adds a useful constraint on the writer (no longer than the previous draft), but its overall 1-10 score is not tied to the per-criterion 1-5 scores, so it is less tightly calibrated.
